source.title: The end structure of a graph: recent results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 90267. Local shard metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identified the exact work as 'The end structure of a graph: Recent results and open problems' and supplied DOI 10.1016/0012-365X(92)90650-5.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/90267 returned a Cloudflare challenge/HTTP 403 rather than a readable technical source. The zbMATH page was treated as a bibliographic resolver, not as extraction evidence.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. Exact-work DOI recovery reached the ScienceDirect landing page for PII 0012365X92906505, which exposed citation metadata and the abstract through search/browser snippets but local direct fetch returned HTTP 403. Because the visible content did not contain the paper's full problem statements, it was rejected as an extraction source.

failure_mode=network_or_dns_failure. Exact-title recovery found the author-hosted DVI listing at the University of Hamburg page and the specific DVI link https://www.math.uni-hamburg.de/home/diestel/papers/End_structure.dvi. The available tools could not retrieve or convert that DVI into readable full text in this sandbox due repeated DNS/fetch failures, so it was not used for extraction.
evidence_refs: curl: Could not resolve host: www.math.uni-hamburg.de

trace.notes: No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work PDF, DVI-converted text, or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered. Search snippets, bibliographic records, abstracts, and resolver metadata were not used as technical evidence.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-90267.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
